title: Comprehension Against the Heavens
author: Hunmeng
description: Ye Xuan died on a rainy street in Hangzhou, pushing a stranger's child out of the path of a truck. He woke up in New York—in a cramped room above a Chinatown bakery, in the body of a student with his name, in a world where the sky burned white twelve years ago and people began to Awaken. The world calls them powers. Ye Xuan sees what they really are: threads of the Great Dao. One look is enough for him to understand a phone, a fighting stance, or another person's gift. But the body he inherited came with unpaid rent, a federal file, and one missing night at Pier 17.
